name: programmer-workflow
description: Per-host approval-gated memory, plan/full-authority workflow, environment preflight, model-based screenshot recognition, stall escalation, instrumented debugging, offline architecture/feature docs, design prototypes, and separate plugin/runtime migration.

interface.displayName: 程序员工作流 / Programmer Workflow
interface.shortDescription: 记忆、环境预检、截图与大模型识别、调试、工程文档与设计原型
interface.longDescription: 把长对话里容易丢失的工作流沉淀成可执行协议：按宿主独立的用户/工作区记忆与审批门、workflowMode 的 Plan/Full authority 审核、Windows/Linux 环境预检与命令缓存、截图复制与大模型视觉识别、三轮卡壳后的行业做法升级、带日志的调试闭环、Architecture.html/Features.html 离线文档，以及 Prototype.html 设计评审。全部本地运行，无云端依赖；插件数据与编辑器运行数据分两阶段迁移。
